description: Write a person's translation of a term's definition, or of a claim's statement and title, into one language (PM-1373) — a new one, or the machine's corrected (get_registry_translations gives its words). Other sites then show it in that language with no «machine-translated» mark. Markdown and $…$ formulas as in the source. 'text' empty takes the person's translation off, and the machine's is shown again. Only for somebody who may write in the project and, for a term, open its source.

id.description: The term's id (list_terms) or the claim's (list_claims).

lang.description: The language, a two-letter code, e.g. 'en'.

text.description: The definition or the statement in that language. Empty removes the person's translation.

title.description: A claim's title in that language. Optional: none keeps the claim's own. A term has none — its word stays as it is.

name: set_registry_translation
title: Set registry translation
